checkout_session_url

cards.title: Authenticated identity
items: The frontend sends user_address_id instead of a full shipping address
Authenticated quote routes are POST /me/checkout/quote and POST /me/checkout/buy-now/quote

cards.title: Order and readiness
items: Authenticated order routes are POST /me/checkout and PUT /me/checkout/buy-now
Order creation rejects a quote the caller does not own
Pending card checkout polls GET /me/checkout/session/readiness?order_ids= every second for up to 30 seconds

cards.title: Cash close
items: After cash order creation the buyer goes to the success page
The buyer can then continue to the authenticated orders route
